name: Garnet Mountain Lookout
design: R-6 flat cab on a 10 ft concrete base
agency: USDA Forest Service, Custer Gallatin National Forest

access.note: Reached by trail, mountain bike, or horseback from the Rat Lake trailhead; not accessible by standard vehicles.

visit.trail_note: Garnet Mountain Trail via Rat Lake; closed to vehicles wider than 50 inches beyond the trailhead.

rental.season: Year-round, subject to winter access conditions
rental.pets: Not stated in the current listing
rules: Road beyond the Rat Lake trailhead is closed to vehicles wider than 50 inches
Wood stove provided for heat and cooking; bring your own water
rental.access_note: Reached by trail, mountain bike, or horseback from the Rat Lake trailhead.
rental.description: An R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot concrete base atop Garnet Mountain south of Bozeman, with lookout use on the site dating to 1930. Sleeps up to four and is booked through recreation.gov.

events.note: First permanent structure: a 2-story 9x9 frame cab moved secondhand from a Fish & Wildlife observatory on Lincoln Mountain.
Present 10 ft concrete base with R-6 flat cab built.
